narrative.overview:
This is an extraction of the built native .NET 8 WinForms visual system, not a proposed redesign. Its charcoal identity header, light neutral sections, and ordered telemetry rows translate the approved music-library detail-view direction into a practical Windows utility. Brand expression resides in hierarchy and restrained color, not a music costume or custom control chrome.

The system uses code-led layout, Windows UI fonts, standard controls and system iconography. Its current release is read-only: apparent hardware settings are disabled capability disclosures, not working configuration features. The document records actual source values; it does not unlock controls, promise calibrated telemetry, or establish runtime accessibility compliance.
keyCharacteristics: Clear device and sampling context above a scrollable single-column workspace.
Two equally weighted temperature readings, followed by ordered source/status rows.
Flat tonal separation and one muted blue action accent.
Native buttons, fields, window chrome and tray behavior.
Explicit unavailable, stale and locked states instead of fabricated values.

rules.name: The System Contrast Rule
rules.body: High contrast replaces authored colors with Windows system colors: Background/Surface/Header → SystemColors.Window; Ink/Muted/HeaderInk → SystemColors.WindowText; Accent → SystemColors.Highlight. No fixed high-contrast RGB values are specified. Control construction assigns colors from these getters; runtime mode-switch propagation is not established.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use the installed Windows UI face and established hierarchy. Do not introduce an external display face, oversized marketing typography, arbitrary font smoothing, or decorative motion to this native Operate surface. Web craft prescriptions are adapted to the explicitly approved native platform.

dos: Do preserve Segoe UI and the exact extracted Theme roles.
Do retain visible labels, units, sources, capability reasons and scroll-managed sections.
Do distinguish unavailable readings, stale retained readings and proposed setting values.
Do leave native control chrome and keyboard affordances intact.
Do describe this build as a read-only telemetry/capability utility.
donts: Don't invent readings, current hardware settings, calibrated RPM or write success.
Don't unlock hardware controls without the separately validated safety contract.
Don't advertise the unavailable-data smoke fixture as live device telemetry.
Don't claim full MSI Center replacement, verified physical high contrast or tested multi-monitor behavior.
Don't add vendor fonts/assets, raster decoration, web UI dependencies or decorative animation.
Don't turn OS-derived button styling into invented authored tokens.

review.method: Independent native finish review of supplied images through vision_analyze, with read-only source and existing verification-document inspection. No nested subagent tool exposed. Not a web detector critique or fresh runtime QA.
review.scope: Presentation and built visual-system documentation only; writes limited to DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json. No UI code edits, tests, app launch, elevation, hardware calls, recapture, build or packaging.

screenshots.limits: Not live device telemetry and not a marketing demonstration of live sensor capability.

screenshots.role: Validated actual unelevated-device full-window PrintWindow capture
screenshots.observedState: GF63 Thin 11UCX, BIOS E16R6IMS.112, EC unidentified, read-only, battery 100%, AC, protected temperature/fan sensors unavailable.
screenshots.limits: Text fits at the true capture, provider wraps and scrollbar manages lower sections. Not evidence of elevated sensor readings, writable features or assistive-technology behavior.

sections.composition: Ship-quality restrained utility composition. Charcoal device context, equal temperature columns and ordered source rows produce a clear reading path without decorative assets. Large Unavailable labels and a generous header favor legibility over first-viewport density; this is a nonblocking density choice. No evidenced collision or text clipping. Lower sections crossing the viewport are scroll-managed, not broken controls.
sections.craftAccessibility: Source specifies Segoe UI 10/12/19/20 point hierarchy and consistent padding/margins. Calculated normal text contrast clears the floor for the enumerated pairs. Native controls, mnemonics, initial Refresh focus and AccessibleName assignments provide a baseline. Static names on changing labels, disabled control rendering, screen-reader announcements, physical high contrast, dynamic high-contrast switching and monitor transitions are not validated. No web-font, custom-radius or 65–75-character prose requirement is imposed on compact native data rows.
sections.productTruthStates: Acceptable honest read-only scope. Unavailable is never replaced with invented zeros; actual Windows power information remains independent of unavailable protected sensors. All hardware controls stay disabled and lack write handlers; proposed charge 80 is labeled not current hardware value. Live telemetry is supported by 5-second visible/30-second hidden automatic polling in TrayContext, not proof that every sensor is available. Last sample is snapshot local time, including partial snapshots, not necessarily last successful protected sensor read. RPM reported retains source/calibration caveats; target percent is not RPM.
sections.behaviorEvidenceLimits: Existing docs report native UI checks for lock states, polling, stale/error/suspension, export/readback, tray lifecycle, disposal and compact scaling. Review inspected source and supplied captures only; did not rerun them. Programmatic 150% scaling preserves locks in test source but does not itself prove every long label fits at physical 150% DPI. Full lower settings and stale/error/busy states are not visible in the supplied captures. Close-to-tray and Exit are source-supported, not newly manually exercised. Elevated independent read results in docs do not turn the unelevated screenshot into live sensor evidence.
sections.dispositionFindings: SHIP for the honestly labeled read-only telemetry/capability release, conditional on separate engineering/security and packaging gates. No material native visual defect established that blocks this scope. Do not ship as a complete writable MSI Center replacement: unresolved write-safety evidence is a feature-release blocker. No rebuild, UI redesign or replacement capture is required by these two presentation states. Recapture lower settings, stale/error and accessibility/DPI variants only before claiming their visual/runtime validation. Nonblocking follow-ups: clearer sampling timestamp semantics; visible in-flight refresh status; clearer unknown identity wording; earlier close-to-tray guidance and sensor-source explanation; verify current screen-reader announcements. Do not prescribe elevation or claim it will unlock controls.

featureReleaseBlockers: Incomplete independently validated safety contracts prevent shipping writable hardware features or claiming complete MSI Center replacement.

findings.title: Snapshot time wording lacks scope
findings.evidence: MainForm.cs:244–252 formats Last sample as local HH:mm:ss even for partial provider snapshots.
findings.recommendation: Later clarify Last checked at or equivalent local-time wording without implying a successful protected-sensor sample.

findings.title: No visible in-flight refresh feedback
findings.evidence: MainForm.cs:231–267 guards overlapping polls but does not update a busy state.
findings.recommendation: Later show sampling-in-progress feedback or disable Refresh only while the read is in flight; retain fail-closed controls.

findings.title: Unknown identity and explanatory copy are less clear than the numeric hierarchy
findings.evidence: Fixture shows Unknown Unknown; live source explanation appears after prominent Unavailable values. Close-to-tray explanation is in the lower diagnostics section.
findings.recommendation: Later use labeled unknown identity, concise established sensor-status explanation and earlier tray guidance; do not invent a provider failure cause.

findings.title: Assistive technology and physical display-state coverage are not established
findings.evidence: TextLabel constructs static AccessibleName values; existing docs explicitly exclude screen-reader, physical high contrast and real monitor transitions. Supplied captures show initial normal-theme viewport only.
findings.recommendation: Verify dynamic announcements, keyboard reachability of lower sections, disabled control contrast, physical high contrast and multi-monitor DPI before making those compliance claims.

review.questionsSkipped: Autonomous review and documentation delegated; no intermediate approval requested. No scope change or UI fixes performed.
review.toolingIssue: Impeccable context recognizes no Windows WinForms platform and mislabeled it web. Native source and supplied captures are authority; no PRODUCT.md change, web detector or invented platform was used.
